title.en: An Act to Amend Subsection (A) of Section Seven Hundred and thirty-three, as Amended, and Section Seven Hundred and thirty-Nine of the Administrative Code, and Insert in Said Code a New Section, Seven Hundred and Forty-three-A.

text.en:
Subsection (a) of section seven hundred and thirty-three of the Administrative Code as amended
by Act Numbered Thirty-five hundred and thirty-six is hereby further amended to read as follows:
"(a) That he is of good moral character;"

Section seven hundred and thirty-nine of the Administrative Code is hereby amended to read as
"Section 739. Issuance of pharmacist's certificate.-An applicant who shall successfully pass the pharmacist's
examination hereinabove prescribed shall receive a certificate of registration as pharmacist: Provided,
however, That if the applicant who has passed the examination has not completed the age of twenty-one years,
a certificate of registration as pharmacist shall not be issued to him until he shall have completed said age of
twenty-one years, and he shall in the meantime not be allowed to practise as pharmacist."

A new section is hereby inserted between sections seven hundred and forty-three and seven
hundred and forty-four of the Administrative Code, to read as follows:
"Section 743-A. Persons exempt from registration.-Pharmacists of other countries called for consultation shall
not be required to register."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 20, 1930.
